rationale: Corrected per .ufo/waves/round-23/preseal-amendment.md (C2 final rules); derivation unchanged in substance from the original proposal, which was derived only from contract.md and S077-S084. Delta versus cases-proposed/CaseBtrfsDevMatch.json: exactly one fixture field added - btrfs_sysfs[8f3c1d2e-4b5a-4c6d-9e8f-0a1b2c3d4e5f].qgroups_enabled = null, required by the amendment ('Add required fixture member qgroups_enabled to each btrfs_sysfs UUID record: true/false/null. qgroups false must pair with enabled=null/mode=null'). Every other fixture member and the whole expectation are byte-identical to the original proposal; the original proposal file is retained untouched. Classification: amendment - 'Absent dir retains disabled/n/a/btrfs_qgroups_dir_absent only on a successful parent inspection.' Here the qgroups directory is absent (qgroups false) and the parent inspection succeeded (the uuid record exists and lists the device dm-0), so quota_state disabled, enforcement n/a, basis btrfs_qgroups_dir_absent - the same row as contract.md:116. Source resolution: amendment - 'lookup RAW decoded source in device_links; use its mapped basename when present, otherwise basename(source). Compare that basename against UUID devices lists. Zero/multiple UUID matches remains unknown.' Raw decoded source /dev/mapper/root maps through device_links to dm-0; exactly one uuid lists dm-0 in its devices, so the btrfs single-uuid rows apply and btrfs_device_unmapped (contract.md:117) does not. Mount resolution: the path /opt/mori/quota-case has exactly one covering mountpoint, '/' (the '/home' btrfs mount is not a covering mountpoint for it; '/proc' and '/dev' are not either), so the amendment's duplicate-covering-mountpoint refusal (unknown/n/a/ambiguous_overmount, fstype=null, mount_point=null, device_check=not_checked) does not trigger; longest component-prefix selection picks '/'; each chosen line is parsed with its own separator and the last three fields, and no line contains a backslash, so no octal decoding or escape rejection applies. Device check: the chosen mount's major:minor 0:26 equals the path st_dev 0:26, so the amendment's preemption rule (mismatch would preempt the filesystem table) is not engaged and device_check = match; the btrfs equality skip (btrfs skips equality only when the stat major is 0) does not apply because there is no mismatch and the stat major is 0. Verdict: no path is enabled and no path is unknown, so exit 0 and finding_id QUOTA_DISABLED (contract.md:132-134, unchanged by the amendment). Supplementary tokens, for the amendment's supplementary checks only: device_check match; quota_option_keys [] (the btrfs super options rw,space_cache,subvolid=5,subvol=/ carry no quota key, and the amendment states that for btrfs the mechanism is sysfs, not options, so the key list is empty); btrfs_qgroups_mode null (the fixture's mode is null). Anomaly reported to L1: the amendment adds a required fixture record member without versioning the fixture schema string - a tool that validates the original mori-quota-fixture-v1 record key set {devices,qgroups,qgroups_mode} would reject this corrected fixture as a setup error, so the amendment's own 'Missing/extra record keys setup' rule must be read against the amended key set {devices,qgroups,qgroups_enabled,qgroups_mode}. Anchors: S082 (proc.rst 3.5 field table :1973-1983, major:minor :1975, separator :1980, fstype :1981, source :1982, super options :1983) for the mountinfo layout; S081 (fs/btrfs/inode.c:8246, stat->dev = BTRFS_I(inode)->root->anon_dev) for btrfs st_dev being the root's per-subvolume anonymous device, i.e. the normal btrfs case is a mismatch and the equal branch used here is the defensive one; S079 (fs/btrfs/sysfs.c qgroup_enabled_show:2355-2368, qgroup_mode_show:2370-2395, qgroups attribute group :2450-2461) and S080 (fs/btrfs/qgroup.c btrfs_sysfs_add_qgroups:441,1032, btrfs_sysfs_del_qgroups:620,689,1295) for the qgroups sysfs surface whose directory absence is a visibility statement, not proof that quota was never possible.
